imageAlt: A level generated through Pavel Zosim's cell-based procedural level generator
summary: A modular, rule-based level generator built in Houdini and cooked into Unreal — why it isn't about mazes, how it borrows structure from real map grids and level-pacing patterns, and how it guarantees a locked door is always solvable.
title: Controlled Procedurality — How a Maze Generator Became a Level Design System
